verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform, so per-account and per-program risk controls are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no transaction or velocity limits, no holds on suspicious activity, and no account freezes or reinstatement paths. The adjacent items (KYC/watchlist verification, enhanced due diligence submission for high-risk customers, and admin access management) are related compliance features, not the requested controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths
